notes: UI: the space between windows now matches the dark top of the page. The body background was a radial gradient with a green center (#04130a) fading to dark at the edges, so the header at the top read dark while the panels and the gaps between them sat in the green center. Flattened --body-bg to the dark edge color (#020703) so the header and the between-window gaps are the same color by construction, and tightened the panel glow (24px to 10px spread, lower alpha) so it no longer bleeds green into the gaps; the bold panel border already defines the windows, so it doesn't need the wide halo. As a bonus, panels now sit on a flat near-black field, which makes them separate even more cleanly. Client CSS only, no server or DB change, hard-refresh to see it. Carries 1.1.9.6 and earlier.
